beats.text: Artazostre is dead. Kain struck the blow himself - and in doing so tore a hole in the order of the world.
A throne left empty does not stay empty. From the peak of Olympus, the gods have been watching the vacuum, and counting.

beats.speaker: Lightbringer
beats.text: I broke a tyrant and inherited a wound. The Titan-veins run open across Boiotia, and every kingdom that swore to me is already reaching for them.

beats.speaker: Lightbringer
beats.text: Zeus sends legions to claim the remnants. Apollo will follow with fire. If the kingdoms of men fight each other over the scraps, Olympus will not need to conquer us - we will hand ourselves over.

beats.speaker: Ironclad Sentry
beats.text: The border holds nothing but ash and my garrison, Avatar. If the divine legions come through here, they come through me first.

beats.speaker: Lightbringer
beats.text: Then we find out what your garrison is worth. Form your ranks, Sentry. I will form mine.
ACT I - THE BROKEN THRONE. Unite the rival kingdoms before Olympus enslaves humanity again.
The mining camps burn. What the divine legions cannot carry from the Titan-veins, they melt into slag so that no mortal hand will hold it.

beats.speaker: Lightbringer
beats.text: They are not looting. They are erasing. Whatever lies under Boiotia, Olympus would rather destroy it than let us learn what it is.
ACT II - ASHES OF BOIOTIA. Reach the deep veins before the legions finish their work.
Apollo does not send envoys. The sky above the human capital turns white, and stays white, and the siege begins.

beats.speaker: Lightbringer
beats.text: Hold the walls. Hold them until the light breaks or we do.
ACT III - THE SUN GOD'S WRATH. Shield the capital against Apollo's siege.
